description: Source code for integrating TaxJar tax calculations and transactions within an ERPNext system, including functions for creating, deleting, and validating tax data, as well as handling addresses and state codes.

methods.name: get_client
methods.description: Initializes and returns a TaxJar client based on sandbox or production settings.

methods.name: create_transaction
methods.description: Creates a sales or refund transaction in TaxJar for a given document.

methods.name: delete_transaction
methods.description: Deletes an existing TaxJar order transaction.

methods.name: get_tax_data
methods.description: Prepares and returns tax data dictionary for an order based on addresses and items.

methods.name: set_sales_tax
methods.description: Calculates and sets sales tax on a document, considering exemptions and nexus.

methods.name: check_for_nexus
methods.description: Checks if the order is within a tax nexus region and adjusts tax data accordingly.

methods.name: check_sales_tax_exemption
methods.description: Determines if the customer is exempt from sales tax and updates tax amounts.

methods.name: validate_tax_request
methods.description: Validates and retrieves tax information from TaxJar for an order.

methods.name: get_company_address_details
methods.description: Retrieves the default company address details.

methods.name: get_shipping_address_details
methods.description: Retrieves the shipping address details for a document.

methods.name: get_iso_3166_2_state_code
methods.description: Gets the ISO 3166-2 state code for an address, validating against supported states.

methods.name: sanitize_error_response
methods.description: Sanitizes and formats error messages from TaxJar responses.
